verdict.rationale: The official GitHub repo publishes Godot's source and states it is "completely free and open source under the very permissive MIT license" (godot-gh-2). The license page confirms the MIT/Expat terms and the freedom to use, modify and redistribute (godot-docs-23, godot-docs-29). Compilation instructions for building from source are also provided (godot-gh-3). Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of reading or building the source beyond first-party statements.
